notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
This update fixes certain issues:
[list]
[*] Scores larger than 100'000 don't turn into negative numbers anymore
[*] The "hot seeds" achievement should now always work. However, it's possible that an existing game session still fails to unlock the achievement. In that case, please restart your exercise in the menu, then it should work. 
[/list]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38067977/93e68155362f7d5d85189122a6841c7da623966e.gif[/img]

Thanks for your patience. Please let us know if there are still any problems.
